issues.where: crops J and K (northern polar region and upper globe, also visible in image-05.png and image-06.png crops A, B, D)
issues.what: Jupiter's cloud surface softens into heavy directional blur and coarse diagonal streaks across the closer second frame, with stretched and mushy polar texels at native crop scale
issues.fix: use a higher-resolution polar-corrected planetary texture (or cube-sphere/multi-tile mapping) and eliminate surface motion or temporal smearing so cloud filaments stay crisp at close range

issues.where: crop F lower-right Milky Way cloud (and continuing vertically down the left third of crop W in image-08.png)
issues.what: a straight vertical tile seam cuts through the Milky Way star cloud where two sky-map edges meet with an abrupt brightness jump
issues.fix: blend or re-project the environment sky map across tile boundaries so no hard vertical mosaic seam appears in the background

issues.where: crops B, C, F, G, H sky background (and matching sky crops in image-03.png, image-06.png, and image-08.png)
issues.what: at native size the Milky Way backdrop shows visible pixel blocks, compression chroma noise, and blocky multi-pixel star blobs
issues.fix: replace the low-resolution sky panorama with a higher-resolution uncompressed starfield and dust map (or procedural sub-pixel stars over smooth high-res nebulosity) with proper filtering

issues.where: crop A moon Io and cast shadow (also image-03.png crop O, image-06.png crop I, and image-07.png crop P)
issues.what: Io's surface texture is visibly pixelated and blurry in the closer frame, with a stair-stepped silhouette, a dark rim artifact on the upper-right edge, and an aliased cast-shadow edge on Jupiter
issues.fix: increase Io's texture map resolution and sphere subdivision, supersample the moon limb, and soften/anti-alias the cast shadow penumbra on the cloud deck

issues.where: crop J upper limb (also lower limb in image-04.png crop S and image-08.png crop T, bright left limb in image-02.png crops B/D, and dark right limb in image-02.png crop C and image-06.png crop E)
issues.what: the bright left atmospheric glow clips to flat white and then disappears abruptly toward both poles, leaving a bare, jagged stair-stepped sphere edge against space and across the Milky Way
issues.fix: extend a smooth, unclipped atmospheric scattering falloff continuously around the lit limb to the poles and apply higher geometric anti-aliasing along both sunlit and dark silhouettes

issues.where: crop C unlit night side of Jupiter
issues.what: faint ambient light leaks onto the dark side past the terminator, revealing isolated cyan concentric storm rings floating in the shadow
issues.fix: clamp night-side ambient illumination to zero past the terminator falloff so unlit cloud albedo does not leak through

issues.where: tile A, Great Red Spot collar and pale belts; same dayside in image-13.png
issues.what: the belts are a little airbrushed: medium swirls are smooth and fine grain is thin, so the disk looks filtered next to the storm crops
issues.fix: add finer filament and grain in the pale zones and around the spot so the native crops stay sharp

issues.where: sky tiles B, D, F, and H, the brightest stars
issues.what: the brightest stars are soft round disks about 5–7 px across with flat clipped centers and a clean radial falloff, so they read as point sprites
issues.fix: shrink bright stars to a 1–2 px core, break the perfect disk, and do not clip a flat white center
